sources.snippet: $DIS closed today near 127, above 126, the target from Clarity Vol. 103 (Jun 12). The order was set back then: reclaim the trigger band, clear the first ceiling, then 126, where an accumulation base turns into markup. The Nov 20 Cycle Report had it pressing toward that target. This came on a light half-day. Markup proves itself when buyers defend the old supply on the retest.
